Mali.title: Solidarity Month: Minister Assa Badiallo Touré and PAHO women alongside the 220 vulnerable people
Mali.summary: Solidarity Month: Minister Assa Badiallo Touré and women from PAHO alongside 220 vulnerable people Food donations, non-food kits and income-generating activities financing, the Minister of Health and Social Development and women from Social Welfare Organizations (PAHO) joined forces to support 220 vulnerable people, this Thursday, October 22, 2026, in Bamako .

Mali.title: Image Published on October 22, 2026 Africa Mali: Human Rights Watch accuses the army and its Russian allies of "new atrocities" against civilians Human Rights Watch (HRW) claims that the Malian army and its Russian paramilitary allies have committed "new atrocities" against civilians in...
Mali.summary: Human Rights Watch (HRW) claims that the Malian army and its Russian paramilitary allies have committed "new atrocities" against civilians in central Mali Human Rights Watch (HRW) claims that the Malian army and its Russian paramilitary allies have committed "new atrocities" against civilians in central Mali, in a report released Thursday .

Mali.title: Border coup: Algerian army shuts down Tinzaouaten and Timiaouine to track down traffickers
Mali.summary: Border coup: Algerian army closes Tinzaouaten and Timiaouine to hunt down traffickers The Algerian army has unleashed a vast security "grooming" operation on its border with Mali, targeting the smuggling of weapons and vehicles, as well as clandestine gold panning As part of this intensive deployment, the Tinzaouaten and Timiaouine border crossings were temporarily closed in order to facilitate controls and clean up the area.

Mali.title: AES – ECOWAS: What future for cooperation?
Mali.summary: The dialogue initiated in Dakar on 17 October should provide a sustainable framework for relations between the ESA and ECOWAS. The movement of people, trade and security call for concrete commitments between the two sets. Institutional separation has not erased interdependencies Since the effective withdrawal of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger from ECOWAS on 29 January 2025, the countries of both sets continue to share trade corridors, population movements and security challenges.

Mali.title: Arm of iron in Bamako: Seydou "Solution" against Mohamed "Lil Bougou", a contract signed on October 16
Mali.summary: The Malian sports arm wrestling federation recorded, on October 16, 2026, the signing of the contract for a fight between Seydou, known as "Solution", and Mohamed, known as "Lil Bougou". The two practitioners received a preparation bonus of 500,000 CFA francs each. The meeting, the date of which remains to be communicated, also provides for a bonus for the winner, the amount of which has not been made public .

Mali.title: Talhandak and Menaka. Targeted FAMa strikes neutralize several terrorists The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the public...
Mali.summary: In a press release published this Thursday, October 22, 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces informs that on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, in the Talhandak sector, the tracking of two motorcyclists made it possible to identify, about 3 km northwest of Talhandak, a point of regroupment of terrorist individuals with several motorcycles and trying to hide under a vegetal cover .

Mali.title: Kayes: two suspects arrested for alleged supply of terrorist armed groups
Mali.summary: Kayes: two suspects arrested for an alleged supply of terrorist armed groups On 16 and 18 October 2026, the Police Station of the 2nd district of Kayes arrested two individuals suspected of supplying fuel to terrorist armed groups (GAT). The first suspect was arrested in Sintiani, on the Kayes-Melga axis, while carrying eight fuel cans concealed in a metal crate .

Mali.title: Mali.. Militants targeted in Tahandalek and Menaka during army operations
Mali.summary: On Thursday, the Malian Army announced the targeting of two military operations in the sectors of Tahandalek and Menaka, which resulted in the targeting of a gathering of militants and the destruction of a vehicle.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: two targeted strikes in Talhandak and Menaka
Mali.summary: According to the General Staff, the FAMa and their allies carried out two surgical strikes in Talhandak and Menaka on 20 and 21 October 2026, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Tuesday, October 20, the tracking of two motorcyclists made it possible to spot a group of individuals presented as terrorists, with several motorcycles, about three kilometers northwest of Talhandak.

Mali.title: Mali: military operation targets' terrorists' near Ngoma Koura
Mali.summary: A strike by the Malian Armed Forces targeted a gathering of motorcyclists in the Ouagadou forest. In addition, the Malian army is continuing its reconnaissance to establish the toll of the strike. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) announced that they had neutralized several fighters in a strike on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 near Ngoma Koura Indeed, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, the target was a group gathered under a tree in the forest of Ouagadou.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike a terrorist position in the Ouagadou forest
Mali.summary: Thanks to the use of precise intelligence, the Malian Armed Forces continue their missions of surveillance and security of the national territory image illustration The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) continue their operations of surveillance, reconnaissance and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Tuesday, October 20, 2026, the exploitation of precise information allowed the units involved to locate a group of motorcyclists in the Ouagadou forest, near the village of Ngoma Koura.

Mali.title: Mali: Youssouf Toloba and Dan Na Ambassagou reaffirm their commitment to the homeland, peace and national unity
Mali.summary: Youssouf Toloba and Dan Na Ambassagou: a call for peace and the strengthening of security in Mali. Faced with disputed information about his alleged encirclement, Dan Na Ambassagou's Chief of Staff enjoys the support of his movement. In Bandiagara, hunters are calling for increased security, better coordination with FAMa and increased attention from Transitional Authorities .

Mali.title: Mali: FAMa strikes two terrorist targets in Talhandak and Menaka
Mali.summary: SECURING the NATIONAL TERRITORY: THE FAMa STRIKE TWO TERRORIST TARGETS IN TALHANDAK and the MENAKA SECTOR Operation Dougoukoloko: the Malian Armed Forces continue their missions of surveillance and neutralization of threats with method, precision and determination. BAMADA.NET – The dynamics of securing the national territory continues in Mali . As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), with the support of their partners, maintain their surveillance, control and reconnaissance missions in several areas of the country .

Mali.title: Mali: The FAMa hit a group of motorcyclists in the Ouagadou forest
Mali.summary: Mali: The FAMa hit a group of motorcyclists in the forest of Ouagadou The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) announce that they carried out a targeted strike on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, against a group of more than a dozen motorcyclists spotted in the forest of Ouagadou, near the village of Ngoma Koura According to our colleagues in Maliweb who cite the General Staff of the Armed Forces, several terrorist elements were neutralized during this operation carried out as part of Operation Dougoukoloko.

Mali.title: Jihadists blamed for Mali attack, 48 dead: sources

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: what the new Penal Code says
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso reinstates the death penalty in its new Penal Code, adopted unanimously. The Ministry of Justice detailed the main innovations. The Burkinabe Ministry of Justice published on its Facebook page on Wednesday a table of the innovations of the new Penal Code, adopted the day before by the 71 members of the People's Legislative Assembly.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: The country reinstates the death penalty (HRW)
Burkina Faso.summary: A scary message for critics of the junta in a context of widespread repression Burkina Faso's unelected parliament unanimously adopted a new penal code that reinstates the death penalty for high treason, terrorism, acts of espionage, parricide and import of expired or prohibited products The country had abolished the death penalty for common crimes in 2018, while its last known judicial execution was in 1988.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: The new Penal Code prohibits funerals for death row inmates, polyandry is now prohibited
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina : Le nouveau Code pénal proscrit les funérailles pour les condamnés à mort exécutés, la polyandrie désormais interdite Au Burkina Faso, l’Assemblée législative du Peuple (ALP) a adopté lors de sa plénière d’hier mardi 20 octobre, le projet de loi portant Code pénal. Ce nouveau texte comprend neuf livres, 33 titres et 97 chapitres, pour un total de plus de 900 articles.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Shooting, lethal injection, hanging... details of the procedure for executing the death penalty
Burkina Faso.summary: The new Burkinabe Criminal Code provides for the reinstatement of the death penalty for several serious crimes and specifies the modalities of its execution. The innovations of the text, four modes of execution are planned: shooting, lethal injection, hanging and electrocution. The system also provides a framework for remedies and the case of pregnant convicted women Adopted unanimously by the 71 voters of the People's Legislative Assembly (Alp) on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, the new Penal Code marks an important development in Burkina Faso's criminal law.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso Restores Death Penalty as Junta Tightens Grip
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso's unelected parliament has unanimously adopted a new penal code restoring the death penalty for offences including high treason, terrorism, espionage, parricide and importing expired or prohibited products. The death penalty for ordinary crimes was abolished in 2018. Human Rights Watch warns that reinstating capital punishment could further threaten civil liberties under the military junta, which took power in a 2022 coup.

Burkina Faso.title: Military cooperation: a delegation of the Turkish gendarmerie in immersion at the gendarmerie of Burkina
Burkina Faso.summary: A delegation of the Turkish gendarmerie is staying in Ouagadougou, as part of a working visit and consolidation of the partnership with the National Gendarmerie of Burkina Faso. This mission is led by Lieutenant General Aykut Tanriverdi, Deputy Commander of the General Command of the Gendarmerie of the Republic of Türkiye It is with the rise of colors, an act highly solemn and rich in symbols that the Turkish delegation began its immersion within the National Gendarmerie of Burkina Faso .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: The main innovations of the new Penal Code
Burkina Faso.summary: The new Burkina Faso Penal Code adopted on 20 October 2026 by the People's Legislative Assembly introduces a dozen main innovations including the reinstatement of the death penalty for certain offences, the revision of financial sanctions related to the misappropriation of public funds, the creation of new offences and the raising of certain penalties. The amendments also concern road traffic, the environment, international crimes, protected animals and offences committed using information and communication technologies.

Niger.title: Two European Women Freed After Kidnap in Niger
Niger.summary: A Swiss woman and an Austrian woman kidnapped in Niger in 2025 have been released after spending more than a year in captivity, their respective governments have confirmed. The women, identified as 69-year-old Swiss national Claudia Abbt and 76-year-old Austrian citizen Eva Gretzmacher, arrived in Benghazi, eastern Libya, following their release, according to local media reports.

Niger.title: Niger and Algeria sign a memorandum of understanding in the field of military cooperation
Niger.summary: The Nigerien Minister of National Defence, Army General Salifou Modi is on a working visit to Algiers. It was yesterday Wednesday, October 21, at the headquarters of the General Staff of the People's National Army (ANP) . After saluting the national flag, listening to the two national anthems and presenting military honours, the Nigerien official had a meeting with Said Chanegriha, Minister Delegate to the Algerian Minister of National Defence, Chief of Staff of the National People's Army .

Niger.title: Haftar stages the release in Benghazi of two hostages kidnapped in Niger
Niger.summary: The two women abducted in 2025 in Agadez, the capital of northern Niger, were released on Wednesday by their captors from the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS), thanks to the good offices of Libyan Marshal and Eastern strongman Khalifa Haftar. Austria's Eva Gretzmacher and Switzerland's Claudia Abbt thank Haftar father and son in the video below, broadcast by al-Masar TV, a Benghazi TV, on platform X .

Niger.title: Algeria and Niger sign "a security pact"
Niger.summary: The Chief of Staff of the Algerian National People's Army and the Nigerien Minister of State in charge of National Defence met in Algiers. Algeria, strongly encouraged by Russia, continues its rapprochement with the Alliance of Sahel States (AES) On 21 October, Niger's Minister of State for National Defence, Salifou Mody, visited Algiers for the second time in two weeks.

Niger.title: Algeria-Niger: a memorandum of understanding to strengthen military cooperation
Niger.summary: Algeria and Niger signed, Wednesday, October 21, 2026, a memorandum of understanding to strengthen their military cooperation The document was initialled by Army General Said Chanegriha, Algerian Minister Delegate to the Minister of National Defence and Chief of Staff of the People's National Army, and Army General Salifou Modi, Nigerien Minister of Defence, on a working visit to Algeria at the head of a large delegation According to Said Chanegriha, this visit reflects the desire of the two countries to consolidate their military cooperation and to meet together the security challenges with efficiency and…

Niger.title: Niger: 12 dead in an armed attack on two passenger buses on the Arlit-Agadez axis (governor)
Algeria and Niger sign a memorandum of military cooperation
Niger: the two European hostages kidnapped by EIGS in Agadez now free after several months of captivity
Niger.summary: Announced as free for a few days, it was on Wednesday 21 October that the two (02) European hostages, Eva Gretzmacher and Claudia Abbt, kidnapped in 2025 in Agadez by the EIGs, reappeared after several months of captivity. They were handed over to the authorities in Benghazi, Libya, before their scheduled return to the country this Thursday, October 22, 2026 .

Niger.title: Military cooperation: Niamey and Algiers sign a new agreement that strengthens their partnership in the fields of Defence and Security
Niger.summary: Algeria and Niger have just signed a new memorandum of understanding on military cooperation which strengthens relations between the two countries in the fields of defence and security.

Niger.title: Niger: Two Western hostages released in Libya after more than 18 months in Islamic State captivity
Niger.summary: Claudia Abbt and Eva Gretzmacher, held hostage by Islamic State in Niger, have been freed and flown to Benghazi following mediation led by Saddam Haftar, who is using the breakthrough to expand his political influence across the Sahel.

Niger.title: Swiss and Austrian women in Libya after release from Niger kidnap ordeal
Niger.summary: An Austrian and a Swiss women kidnapped in Niger more than a year and a half ago have been freed and are in Libya, Bern and Vienna announced Thursday. Sixty-nine-year-old Swiss national Claudia Abbt and 76-year-old Eva Gretzmacher arrived in the eastern city of Benghazi where they received medical treatment. Their release follows an intervention by Libyan military commander Khalifa Haftar, who controls the east and parts of the south of the country.

Niger.title: Two former European hostages kidnapped in Niger in 2025 have been released and are in Libya
Niger.summary: Eva Gretzmacher and Claudia Abbt, two European women kidnapped in the Sahel in 2025, are free, a Libyan television channel has announced. The announcement was confirmed Thursday, October 22 thanks to images of the two ex-hostages who arrived in Benghazi Because it was through the strong man of eastern Libya, Marshal Khalifa Haftar, that they regained their freedom.

Niger.title: Read more: Swiss and Austrian hostages freed in Niger
Niger.summary: Swiss and Austrian hostages freed in Niger Two European nationals, a Swiss woman and an Austrian woman, who were kidnapped in Niger over a year ago, have been released. They have arrived in Benghazi, in eastern Libya, a local television channel announced during the night between Wednesday and Thursday. “Two hostages, a Swiss woman and an Austrian woman, have been released after a year and a half in captivity in Niger and have arrived in Benghazi thanks to the intervention of the Deputy Commander-in-Chief,” Saddam Haftar, deputy commander-in-chief of Libya’s armed forces, said Libyan television Al-Masar announced.

Niger.title: Mali: The Palace Guard Against the Trenches - What the Mutiny in Niamey Revealed (African Arguments)
Niger.summary: The mutiny that broke out in air base 101 in Niamey in the night of 29 August 2026 failed. The real question now is to understand why it took place. Those who took up arms against General Abdourahamane Tiani were young soldiers from the front lines, those who fought the 'jihadists.' For all of the Sahel, it's a much more worrying sign than any plot from the army high command.

Niger.title: Two European Hostages Freed in Niger
Niger.summary: Two European women abducted in Niger in 2025 have been released after spending more than a year in captivity, according to Libyan media reports. Swiss national Eva Gretzmacher, 76, and Austrian citizen Claudia Abbt, 69, arrived in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi following their release. Libya’s eastern-based Al-Masar TV reported that the two women had been freed after being held hostage in Niger for about a year and a half.

Niger.title: Niger-Algeria military cooperation: a new strategic partnership for the security of the Sahel and regional sovereignty
Niger.summary: The signing of a military cooperation protocol between Niamey and Algiers marks a new stage in the rapprochement between the two countries. Faced with cross-border security challenges, this initiative opens up prospects for consultation and collaboration, in a region where States intend to have greater control over their strategic choices and strengthen their defence capacities BAMADA.NET - Regional cooperation in the field of defence remains a major issue for Sahel-Saharan countries.

Niger.title: Niger-Libya: Eva Gretzmacher and Claudia Abbt released and arrived in Benghazi
Niger.summary: Austria's Eva Gretzmacher and Switzerland's Claudia Abbt, kidnapped separately in Agadez in 2025, were released and arrived in Benghazi, eastern Libya, on Wednesday, 21 October. Their submission to the Austrian and Swiss authorities must take place after the completion of the necessary formalities . According to our information, a plane was to leave Benghazi on Thursday, October 22, stop in Vienna to hand over Eva Gretzmacher to the Austrian authorities, then continue to Switzerland with Claudia Abbt.
